name: smwsprites-treasure-chest
title: Treasure Chest
description:
A treasure chest from Super Mario Bros. 3. It can spawn a sprite or put a sprite in the player's item box. Optionally, it can end the level, too (only if putting a sprite in the item box). There is also a version which contains a coin and gives 1-Ups and a version which contains a bonus coin (from the pink berry cloud minigame) and gives 1-Ups.

Non-standard sprites in the item box will have glitched graphics unless you apply Kenny3900's Item Box GFX Fix patch or imamelia's Item Box Special patch.

This sprite makes heavy use of the extra byte. Make sure to check the readme for detailed usage instructions.
